reviews.text: Shamrock pools was fantastic. Our pool caved in and we needed it removed and another one installed. They gave an estimate below all the other pool companies the day after I called. They took in down and installed a fantastic above ground in under 24 hours from take down to water filling the new pool. Hardworking crew! They got right to business and finished the job by cleaning all and making sure not to leave any scraps. Thank you Shamrock Pools!
reviews.author: Ed Connors

reviews.text: Shamrock Pools ☘️ replaced our liner for our in ground pool. Absolutely love the new look and the project was done on time and on budget.
reviews.author: Grannis Construction, LLC

reviews.text: I recommend that you avoid Shamrock pools.Visit with other pool contractors and ask if they've repaired Shamrock pools. Dan accepted payment and could not do what he contracted to do. He led me on for months. I had to pursue him in court to get my deposit back!
reviews.author: Jay Hodgens

reviews.text: Highly recommend Shamrock Pools! They were professional, timely, and very experienced.  They responded right away when we had a problem with the initial people we hired to install our pool. Would definitely use shamrock pools again.

data.summary: The reviews show a mix of highly satisfied and severely dissatisfied customers. The positive reviews contain specific, plausible details. However, the negative reviews form a clear, consistent pattern of communication breakdowns, scheduling failures, and one serious allegation of a deposit dispute requiring legal action. The low total review count is a concern for an established business. The authenticity of individual reviews is medium-high, but the business practices reflected are questionable.
fake_signals: Low review volume (9) for an established contractor
Polarized ratings with extreme 5-star and 1-star reviews
One 5-star review from a business (Grannis Construction, LLC) which could be reciprocal
authentic_signals: Specific project details (pool cave-in, liner replacement)
Consistent complaint theme across multiple negative reviews
Varied author names and writing styles
complaint_patterns: Deposit/contract dispute leading to legal action
data.discrepancy_explanation: Insufficient rating data from multiple platforms to detect a meaningful discrepancy. Only Google provides a rating.
